Course Overview

Definition and importance of Data Engineering

Definition:Data engineering is the practice of designing, building, and maintaining systems

that enable efficient collection, storage, and processing of data.

Importance:

  • Ensures data is clean, reliable, and accessiblefor analysis.
  • Supports business intelligence and AIby providing structured data.
  • Enables real-time and batch processingfor various use cases.
  • Forms the foundation of data-driven decision-making.

Data Engineering versus Data Science

Aspect

Data Engineering

Data Science

Focus

Building & managing data pipelines

Analyzing& interpreting data

Goal

Ensuring data availability & quality

Extracting insights & predictions

Skills

SQL, Python, ETL, cloud, databases

Machine learning, statistics, visualization

Output

Data pipelines, warehouses, APIs

Models, reports, dashboards

Analogy: Data engineers build the highways, while data scientists drive the cars

Data Storage: Data Warehouse versus Data Lake

Feature

Data Warehouse

Data Lake

Data Type

Structured and processed

Raw, structured and unstructured

Storage Cost

Higher (optimized for queries)

Lower (scalable storage)

Processing Speed

Optimized for fast SQL queries

Slower for queries

Data Quality

High-quality, cleansed data

Raw data, duplicates & errors

Use Case

Business Intelligence, reporting

Big Data, Machine Learning

Batch versus Real-Time Data Processing

Feature

Batch Processing

Real-Time Processing

Processing Mode

Periodic (scheduled jobs)

Continuous (event-driven)

Latency

Higher (hours or days)

Low (seconds)

Data Freshness

Historical data

Live streaming data

Complexity

Easier to implement and debug

More complex due to real-time event handling

Use Case

Reporting, ETL, historical analysis

Fraud detection, IoT monitoring, live dashboards

How Data Engineers SolveThese Challenges:
